summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography stub about Jim Wilson, a first baseman. It covers his release by the Indians after the 1986 season, a brief stint in the Minnesota Twins organization, and his signing as a free agent with the Seattle Mariners in March 1988, when he played five games for them in 1989.
